title: Microsoft Purview: auto-labeling ceiling for SharePoint and OneDrive rises to 500,000 files a day (Worldwide)
summary: The rollout, licensing, daily ceiling and documented control paths are supported. However, the governance explanation incorrectly says all listed controls act on individual policies: its auditing switch affects the whole organization. Correct that scope statement before publication.

claims.claim: The maximum SharePoint and OneDrive auto-labeling capacity increases from 100,000 to up to 500,000 files per tenant per day.
claims.quote: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn documents 500,000 files per tenant per day as the aggregate absolute maximum across all auto-labeling policies.
claims.quote: The absolute maximum throughput is 500,000 automatically labeled SharePoint and OneDrive files per tenant per day, in aggregate across all auto-labeling policies.

claims.quote: This ceiling isn't a guaranteed or consistently expected daily processing rate; actual throughput can be lower.

claims.quote: Auto-labeling policies run continuously until they're deleted.

claims.claim: Policies include new and modified files using their current settings.
claims.quote: For example, new and modified files will be included with the current policy settings.

claims.claim: Service-side auto-labeling runs without user interaction.
claims.quote: Because the user doesn't interact with the labeling process, auto-labeling policies don't support recommended labeling

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout

claims.quote: When the auto-labeling policy includes locations for SharePoint or OneDrive, the label must be configured for the Assign permissions now setting

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: For those encrypting labels, User access to content expires must be Never.
claims.quote: User access to content expires must be set to Never.

claims.claim: Label-applied encryption can make files unreadable to people without the required rights.
claims.quote: When a document, email, or meeting invite is encrypted, access to the content is restricted, so that it: ... Can be decrypted only by users authorized by the label's encryption settings.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/encryption-sensitivity-labels to sources for the statement that encryption restricts access to authorized users.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A policy can be configured to replace a lower-priority manually applied label.
claims.quote: For auto-labeling policies that apply a sensitivity label, you can select a setting to override a manually applied label that has lower priority.

claims.claim: A SharePoint or OneDrive label-removal policy can remove its selected label even when manually applied.
claims.quote: for SharePoint and OneDrive, an auto-labeling policy configured to automatically remove a label can remove the selected label, including when the label was manually applied, and leave the content unlabeled.

claims.claim: A policy must run at least one simulation before automatically applying or removing labels.

claims.quote: Files can't be auto-labeled if they're part of an open session (the file is open).

claims.claim: PDFs are skipped unless PDF labeling is enabled for the tenant.
claims.quote: If PDF labeling isn't enabled, PDFs are skipped entirely: PDFs aren't evaluated or sent for labeling, and no label is applied.

claims.quote: This progress information updates every 48 hours, so you can expect to see the most current data about every other day.

claims.quote: Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies. ... For a policy in the Off section, select the Edit policy button. ... For the page Choose locations where you want to apply the label: Select and specify locations for Exchange, SharePoint, and OneDrive.

claims.claim: Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity <PolicyIdParameter> -AddSharePointLocation <SharePointSites> modifies the policy's included SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: [-Identity] <PolicyIdParameter> ... The AddSharePointLocation parameter specifies the SharePoint sites to add to the list of included sites when you aren't using the value All for the SharePointLocation parameter. You identify the site by its URL value.

claims.claim: The policy cmdlet runs in Security & Compliance PowerShell and uses AddOneDriveLocation to add OneDrive sites.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell. ... The AddOneDriveLocation parameter specifies the OneDrive sites to add to the list of included sites when you aren't using the value All for the OneDriveLocation parameter.

claims.claim: The portal limit of 1,000 explicitly included or excluded SharePoint sites does not apply when the default All is retained.
claims.quote: In the portal, each policy can target up to 1,000 explicitly included or excluded SharePoint sites ... If you keep the default configuration of All, this configuration is exempt from these maximums.

The increase applies to existing active policies; no automatic policy creation or other change for policy-free tenants was documented for this update.

claims.claim: All controls in the table act on individual policies.
claims.quote: These controls act on individual policies; ... Whether the unified audit log records activity (required for simulation) ... scope: "tenant"
claims.fix: Delete 'These controls act on individual policies;' from the paragraph after the table and capitalize the following 'The'. The table already correctly identifies auditing as tenant-scoped.

claims.claim: The prepare action rating matches the scale despite a launched automatic change, medium risk and policy decisions to take.
claims.quote: status: "launched"; risk: "medium"; defaultState: "on"; action: "prepare". Governance guidance: decide whether any should stay in simulation until its results are reviewed.
claims.fix: Set action to 'act-now': the assessment scale assigns it to a launched change that reaches data automatically, has medium-or-higher risk or cost, and has controls or decisions for administrators.
